_about: Colorado Front Range pest calendar for TraversePest (2026-10-06). One line per pest for the rep, each from a named source; months are when the line shows. Copied to app/data/rounds/pest-season.json by build-pest.mjs. Re-check the sources each spring.

miller.name: Miller moths
miller.line: Miller moth flights usually start between mid-May and early June and last five to six weeks.

elmseed.name: Elm seed bugs
elmseed.line: Elm seed bugs move into homes from mid-June through September.

mosquito.name: Mosquitoes
mosquito.line: Mosquito season runs from late June to the first frost; West Nile risk is highest in late summer.

wasps.name: Wasps and yellowjackets
wasps.line: Yellowjackets are at their worst late in summer and into fall.

boxelder.name: Boxelder bugs
boxelder.line: Boxelder bugs gather on warm walls in fall, looking for a place to spend the winter.

mice.name: Mice
mice.line: Mice look for a warm way indoors as the nights turn cold.

voles.name: Voles
voles.line: Voles tunnel through lawns under the snow; the damage shows when it melts.
